text: The overworld place-name system is HELD end-to-end and machine-reproducible from the shipped WEB client. getPlaceName(territoryID) splits the id into territoryx = id>>12 & 0xFFF and territoryy = id & 0xFFF, takes namex = territoryx % 137 and namey = territoryy % 26, and either indexes the 677-entry place table at [namex*26+namey] (when namex < 26) or composes namestarting[RNG(id*2).rand(78)] + nameending[rand(37)]. Run unmodified against the coordinates visible in the frames it produces 'Chikada' (tid 1405270), 'Kakuchi' (1409366) and 'Kasuta' (1397077) exactly. Two territory IDs are hard-coded overrides: 1405272 -> 'Ibamaya', 1524045 -> 'Gokura'. The on-screen location bar is a three-part composite: direction + getPlaceName(territoryID) + a room-type string from the string table (strings.json["1005"]='Mine', ["1015"]='Mountain Path', ["1003"]='Forest').
